conflictResolutionStrategy.method: For each conflicting path, identify canonical owner/source and compare full blobs/lineage; classify as KEEP_MAIN, ADOPT_CANDIDATE, MERGE_SEMANTIC, QUARANTINE or SUPERSEDE with evidence; require human/Kernel authorization for restricted categories.
conflictResolutionStrategy.prohibited: No automatic winner chosen from branch date, filename, or recency alone.
